summary_paragraph: Ms. ___ was admitted for bilateral toe amputations due to dry gangrene, a complication from prior ICU stay and pressor use. She underwent uneventful amputation of three toes. Postoperatively, she developed fever and respiratory symptoms; chest imaging revealed a new left lung opacity, leading to a diagnosis of pneumonia. She was treated with levofloxacin, with clinical and radiographic improvement. Physical therapy cleared her for discharge home with home health services. She was discharged on postoperative day five in stable condition, with instructions for wound care, activity restrictions, and completion of antibiotic course. Follow-up was arranged with surgery and primary care.
